description: This source file defines the feature for creating comments in the application. It includes data models, validation, and a handler for processing comment creation requests, interacting with the database via Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains nested records for comment data, command, and model, as well as the command validator and the request handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Create comment command by retrieving the article and author, creating the comment, saving it to the database, and returning the comment envelope.
